title: Stripe event banner
description: Full-width dark rounded panel lit by fans of orange, pink and violet ribbon rising like stage light over a dark floor, with a white light-weight headline, a white button and a small two-weight event wordmark.
notes: the panel is always dark (adds the dark class) and sits in the light page frame
the art is stripe-ribbon (SVG) plus gradients; swap in a photo by wrapping your own img if you have one
